_comment: Ayahs that render with NO colour after the full pipeline (incl. #291 overlay: hamzat-wasl, tafkhim/tarqiq). These are CORRECT, not a gap: their only tajweed features are ones the KFGQPC colouring convention (shared by quran.com, alquran.cloud, and cpfair) deliberately leaves uncoloured — (a) natural madd written with a plain full alif ا, (b) word-final / ayah-final (stop) madd, and (c) izhar (noon-sakin/tanwin before a throat letter). Proof that this is the convention, not a defect: in the shipped corpus `mn` is painted on a word-MEDIAL dagger-alif 7135x but on a plain full-alif 0/6236x and on a word-FINAL dagger-alif 0/6236x. Colouring these 22 would make them INCONSISTENT with the other 6214 ayahs. Verified against 4 sources (quran.com uthmani_tajweed, alquran.cloud quran-tajweed, cpfair precomputed + cpfair's engine run live) — all four annotate none of them. See docs/nimaz-pro-data-guide.md. Allow-list may only SHRINK.
